steps.title: 1. Add product A two times and product B one time: counter 3
2. The basket shows both products and the total 20.97¤
3. Checkout, select the saved address and continue: delivery page opens
4. Select One Day Delivery and continue: payment page opens
5. Redeem the coupon of the current month
6. Select the saved card and continue: order summary with 19.86¤
7. Place the order: the confirmation page opens
8. The confirmation shows both products and the totals
9. The basket counter is 0 and the basket is empty
10. Order history shows the order with the total 19.86¤
